preservedResponsibilities: Original Calendar owner now has default/adopted/reference/copy constructor paths, base assignment, actual owned zone, root-initialized Locale metadata, platform UTC getNow, locale/week/weekend data, field/stamp/time cache and complete inherited UTC/field algorithms. Original constructor guard/clear/zone ordering is retained; LocalPointer(null,status) sets memory error before the explicit unreachable null-argument branch (CALC-342). Reference overloads use a transient tag so a clone callback that changes status still leaves the nonnull clone adopted as source. Calendar remains abstract for its actual virtual arithmetic/clone interface, not because construction is replaced by a placeholder. getLocale returns a Locale value, while LocaleBased supplies shared selector/ID semantics. Original zone adopt/set/orphan behavior including CALC-319 and existing CALC-310/311 time behavior remain unchanged.

Unchanged ICU78.3 library witnesses pass 14994 locale/week cases over 993 requested names and 1440 constructor/copy/weekend cases. They observe all six week/weekend fields, valid/actual Locale values and literal root IDs, incoming error/warning behavior, default and keyword timezone selection, reference/adoption clone counts, null/error and aliased-status clone callbacks, all initialized field/stamp/flag and derived state, date-versus-clock initialization, completed UTC fields and weekend work clones. Existing 63050 scalar/calendar and 12929 time cases also pass after fixtures use real constructors and explicit public controlled baselines.
omittedResponsibilities: Generic Calendar service/cache/registration and non-Gregorian calendar classes, remaining unconsumed APIs (including add/roll and custom cutover mutation), LibreOffice calendar-service/formatter/CSV completion, native allocation/OOM/destructor/ABI/RTTI/undefined or uninitialized memory and platform fake-clock facilities remain uncertified. No unsupported-calendar error or alternate type-selection heuristic is supplied for those unported responsibilities.
